content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Secretary-General position at the International Maritime Organization. Tell about your experience in maritime policy, maritime safety, and marine environment protection. Describe your vision for the IMO's role in combating climate change and reducing emissions from maritime transport. Length about 450 words.
